inventory.testOnlyHttpServers: temporary local fixtures in proof scripts; no served product route
inventory.binding: Claude Code host-native plugin UI through ui.open and ui.render for Pane
inventory.protocolReference: Claude Code host plugin API type contract for ui.open, ui.render, ui.close, InputProps, SelectProps, ButtonProps, and ui.input

picker.search: case-insensitive account-name substring, applied after a 250 ms debounce
picker.metadataLoading: current filtered page only, after picker render
picker.rowCache: in-memory for the current bounded page only
picker.virtualization: host Select has no virtualized list API and accepts at most 64 options; Select windows cap at 64 and Button fallback windows cap at 200
picker.routeCodeSplitting: not-applicable-plugin-host; picker rendering and account metadata reads are deferred until the pane opens
picker.sessionBoundary: session.end and session.start reset transient picker state

conformance.errorBinding: local loading, retry and terminal states; HTTP problem responses do not apply
